description.short: Scores every prompt 1-100 for prompt-engineering quality.
description.full: Prompt Score v0.6.0 (2026-10-27) grades each prompt from 1 to 100 on goal, context, constraints, output format, success criteria, specifics, structure and length, shows the biggest gap, and offers breakdown, tips, rewrite and history. A fast offline heuristic (Hebrew and English), not an LLM judgment.
